explain_field.say: A CKYC number is your 14-digit central KYC ID, which saves you re-submitting documents. It's on your CKYC card or in a bank's KYC email.

card.lead: A 14-digit ID from India's central KYC registry.

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: A 14-digit ID from India's central KYC registry.

rows.label: Where to find it
rows.value: In a KYC confirmation SMS or email from a bank, or on the CKYC card.

rows.label: Common mistake
rows.value: Entering your PAN or Aadhaar number instead.

explain_field_page.say: IFSC is your bank branch's 11-character code, like SBIN0001234. It's on your cheque book or in your bank app.

card.lead: An 11-character code that identifies your bank branch.

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: An 11-character code that identifies your bank branch.

rows.label: Where to find it
rows.value: On your cheque book, your passbook or in your bank app.

rows.label: Format
rows.value: 4 letters, a zero, then 6 letters or numbers, like SBIN0001234.

rows.label: Common mistake
rows.value: Typing the letter O instead of the zero in the fifth place.

risks.title: Repayments are auto-debited
risks.detail: Payments are collected automatically from your bank account.
risks.quote: EMIs are collected automatically on the 5th of every month through the NACH e-mandate or UPI AutoPay set up at application.

risks.title: Fee to repay early
risks.detail: Closing the loan early costs extra.
risks.quote: No foreclosure is allowed in the first 3 months from the date of disbursal.

risks.title: Charges for late or failed payments
risks.detail: Missed or failed payments add charges.
risks.quote: A late fee of ₹500 is charged for each missed instalment, in addition to the instalment itself.

risks.title: Disputes go to arbitration
risks.detail: Disputes are decided by an arbitrator instead of a court.
risks.quote: All disputes arising under this agreement go to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed by QuickCred.

risks.title: Shares your data with partners
risks.detail: Your information can be shared with partners and affiliates.
risks.quote: The Borrower consents to QuickCred sharing their information with partners, affiliates, credit bureaus and service providers, including for marketing.

risks.title: Renews automatically
risks.detail: A plan renews on its own unless you cancel.
risks.quote: It is added at checkout and renews monthly until cancelled, with each monthly fee charged through the mandate.

risks.title: Cancelling needs notice
risks.detail: You have to give notice before you can cancel.
risks.quote: You may cancel QuickCred Plus by giving 30 days' written notice to support@quickcred.example.
